notes.title: Demo update: fewer bugs, better performance and faster loading times.
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]We have released a small update for the [b]Junkienator[/b] demo, based on some of your initial feedback and internal optimisations. Many thanks to everyone who tried it![/p][p]Here are the main changes you'll find in this new version:[/p][list][*][p][b]Performance improvements[/b]: We've worked to resolve some scene loading issues and make the game lighter on all platforms. Loading and performance should now be better on all platforms.[/p][/*] [/list][list][*][p][b]Gamepad fix[/b]: We fixed a bug that didn't show the on-screen buttons correctly when using a controller, especially during the burial puzzle.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Graphics fix[/b]: We have fixed a minor colour correction issue that could occur in the last level.[/p][/*][/list][p]Please download the latest version of the demo to try out these improvements. Your feedback is invaluable to us, so please let us know what you think.[/p][p][b]Thank you again for your support![/b][/p]
